outcome: type of anesthesia used during cesarean delivery
cohort: Pregnant women who tested positive for COVID-19 at eight medical centers in Spain, Israel, and Portugal between April 1st and July 31st, 2020
finding: Women with respiratory symptoms had a higher frequency of emergency cesarean delivery and a higher rate of intrauterine fetal death.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was more frequent in women with respiratory symptoms (65% vs 22.1%).
